items.title: OU vs. Ole Miss postponed to Sunday after travel issues
items.summary:
Oklahoma's game with Ole Miss has been moved to Sunday. 

On Friday afternoon, the Federal Aviation Administration issued a ground stoppage for all U.S. flights “due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety.” That forced Ole Miss to delay its travel to Oklahoma. Ole Miss chose to fly on Saturday morning instead, which is why the game had to be moved to Sunday. Ole Miss was the only SEC school that chose to leave on Saturday instead of Friday. No other SEC game had to be moved to Sunday -- only Oklahoma's.
